## Setup

### 1. Start TEI (Text Embeddings Inference)

- Via Python (no Docker):
  ```bash
  brew install text-embeddings-router
  text-embeddings-router --model sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 --port 8080
  ```

<!-- - Via Docker:
  ```bash
  docker run -p 8080:80 ghcr.io/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference:cpu \
    --model-id sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
  ``` -->

### 2. Start Qdrant (optional, for ANN search)

- Binary:
  ```bash
  ./qdrant
  ```
- Docker:
  ```bash
  docker run -p 6333:6333 -p 6334:6334 qdrant/qdrant
  ```

Then create a collection (dimension 384 for MiniLM-L6-v2; adjust to your model):

```r
library(autotagr)
qdrant_create_collection("bioagora", size = 384, distance = "Cosine")
```

## Minimal Example (binary include/exclude)

```r
library(autotagr)
library(tibble)

df_labeled <- tibble(
  id = c("A1","A2","A3","A4"),
  text = c(
    "Biodiversity loss impacts ecosystem services and human wellbeing.",
    "Ecosystem restoration supports biodiversity targets and NBSAPs.",
    "Quantum computing for lattice models (unrelated).",
    "High-energy physics experiment on collider data."
  ),
  label = c(1,1,0,0)
)

df_unlabeled <- tibble(
  id = c("U1","U2","U3"),
  text = c(
    "Nature-based solutions help climate adaptation and biodiversity.",
    "Particle physics advances in hadron collisions.",
    "Spatial planning for protected areas and OECMs."
  )
)

res <- run_autotag(df_labeled, df_unlabeled,
                   tei_url = "http://localhost:8080/embed")

res$threshold
head(res$scores)
```

The output parquet (`autotag_scores.parquet`) contains per-document scores and decisions.

## Multi-label Example

For multi-label tagging (e.g., thematic tags), provide a long-format labeled set:

```r
df_lab_long <- tibble::tibble(
  id = c("A1","A1","A2","A3","A3","A4"),
  text = c(
    "Biodiversity and ecosystem services in protected areas.",
    "Biodiversity and ecosystem services in protected areas.",
    "Governance and policy coherence for NBSAPs.",
    "Quantum computing for lattice models.",
    "Quantum computing for lattice models.",
    "Collider data analysis."
  ),
  tag = c("biodiversity","planning","governance","physics","biodiversity","physics"),
  label = c(1,0,1,1,0,1)
)

res_ml <- run_autotag_multilabel(df_lab_long, df_unlabeled,
                                 tei_url = "http://localhost:8080/embed")

head(res_ml$scores)
```

## Notes

- Choose TEI model and vector size consistently with your Qdrant collection.
- You can integrate DuckDB by storing embeddings and metadata alongside IDs.
- For ANN label propagation, use `qdrant_search_batch()` over a labeled-only collection
  and compute a distance-weighted vote to add as a third ensemble input.
